mapper.insert: insert into batch.alert_event ( tenant_id, service_name, alert_type, severity, title, detail_json, dedup_fingerprint, trace_id, status ) values ( #{entity.tenantId}, #{entity.serviceName}, #{entity.alertType}, #{entity.severity}, #{entity.title}, CAST(#{entity.detailJson} AS jsonb), #{entity.dedupFingerprint}, #{entity.traceId}, coalesce(#{entity.status}, #{defaultStatus}) ) on conflict (tenant_id, dedup_fingerprint) do update set title = excluded.title, detail_json = excluded.detail_json, trace_id = excluded.trace_id, occurrence_count = batch.alert_event.occurrence_count + 1, last_seen_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM batch.alert_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dedup_fingerprint = #{fingerprint}
SELECT * FROM batch.alert_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKED', 'SUPPRESSED') ORDER BY am_last_reemit_at ASC NULLS FIRST, first_seen_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT alert.* FROM batch.alert_event alert WHERE alert.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND alert.status = 'CLOSED' AND alert.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.alert_notification_receipt receipt WHERE receipt.tenant_id = alert.tenant_id AND receipt.dedup_fingerprint = alert.dedup_fingerprint AND receipt.resolved_delivered_at >= alert.closed_at ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.alert_notification_receipt receipt WHERE receipt.tenant_id = alert.tenant_id AND receipt.dedup_fingerprint = alert.dedup_fingerprint AND receipt.firing_delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND (receipt.resolved_delivered_at IS NULL OR receipt.resolved_delivered_at < alert.closed_at OR receipt.updated_at > receipt.resolved_delivered_at) ) ) ORDER BY alert.am_last_reemit_at ASC NULLS FIRST, alert.closed_at ASC, alert.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH target AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT alert.*, CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(alert.detail_json ->> 'jobInstanceId', 'bigint') THEN (alert.detail_json ->> 'jobInstanceId')::bigint END AS job_instance_id, CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(alert.detail_json ->> 'workflowDefinitionId', 'bigint') THEN (alert.detail_json ->> 'workflowDefinitionId')::bigint END AS definition_id, split_part(alert.detail_json ->> 'monitoringResourceKey', ':', 1) AS resource_kind, CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(split_part( alert.detail_json ->> 'monitoringResourceKey', ':', 2), 'bigint') THEN split_part(alert.detail_json ->> 'monitoringResourceKey', ':', 2)::bigint END AS resource_id FROM batch.alert_event alert WHERE alert.tenant_id = #{entity.tenantId} AND alert.id = #{entity.id} AND alert.status = #{entity.status} AND alert.status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKED', 'SUPPRESSED') AND alert.closed_at IS NULL AND alert.updated_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{entity.updatedAt} AND alert.service_name = 'batch-orchestrator' AND alert.alert_type IN ( 'JOB_SLA_VIOLATION', 'JOB_SLA_VIOLATION_ESCALATED', 'JOB_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE', 'JOB_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE', 'JOB_RUNNING_TOO_LONG', 'WORKFLOW_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE', 'WORKFLOW_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE', 'WORKFLOW_RUNNING_TOO_LONG') ), job_state AS ( SELECT target.id AS alert_id, CASE target.alert_type WHEN 'JOB_SLA_VIOLATION' THEN true WHEN 'JOB_SLA_VIOLATION_ESCALATED' THEN true WHEN 'JOB_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE' THEN COALESCE(policy.start_grace_seconds > 0, false) WHEN 'JOB_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE' THEN COALESCE( policy.completion_deadline_local_time IS NOT NULL OR policy.dependency_completion_window_seconds > 0, false) WHEN 'JOB_RUNNING_TOO_LONG' THEN COALESCE(policy.soft_runtime_seconds > 0, false) END AS policy_enabled, CASE WHEN target.alert_type = 'JOB_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE' THEN COALESCE(source.execution_started_at, completed.finished_at) ELSE completed.finished_at END AS recovered_at, 'RECOVERED'::text AS recovery_reason FROM target JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT job.job_definition_id, job.execution_started_at, job.finished_at, job.instance_status, job.dry_run, job.expected_duration_seconds, job.deadline_at FROM batch.job_instance job WHERE job.tenant_id = target.tenant_id AND job.id = target.job_instance_id UNION ALL SELECT job.job_definition_id, job.execution_started_at, job.finished_at, job.instance_status, job.dry_run, job.expected_duration_seconds, job.deadline_at FROM archive.job_instance_archive job WHERE job.tenant_id = target.tenant_id AND job.id = target.job_instance_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batch.job_instance hot WHERE hot.tenant_id = target.tenant_id AND hot.id = target.job_instance_id) ) source ON target.alert_type IN ( 'JOB_SLA_VIOLATION', 'JOB_SLA_VIOLATION_ESCALATED', 'JOB_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE', 'JOB_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE', 'JOB_RUNNING_TOO_LONG') LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT stored.* FROM batch.job_monitoring_policy stored WHERE stored.tenant_id = target.tenant_id AND stored.job_definition_id = source.job_definition_id FOR SHARE ) policy ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN source.instance_status IN ( 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED', 'SUCCESS_DRY_RUN', 'FAILED_DRY_RUN') THEN source.finished_at END AS finished_at ) completed WHERE source.dry_run = false AND COALESCE(target.detail_json ->> 'monitoringResourceKey', '') NOT LIKE 'workflow_job_request:%' AND ( target.alert_type NOT IN ('JOB_SLA_VIOLATION', 'JOB_SLA_VIOLATION_ESCALATED') OR ( target.detail_json ->> 'violationReason' = 'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED' AND source.deadline_at IS NOT NULL ) OR ( target.detail_json ->> 'violationReason' = 'EXPECTED_DURATION_EXCEEDED' AND source.expected_duration_seconds > 0 AND source.execution_started_at IS NOT NULL ) ) ), job_request_state AS ( SELECT target.id AS alert_id, CASE target.alert_type WHEN 'JOB_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE' THEN COALESCE(policy.start_grace_seconds > 0, false) WHEN 'JOB_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE' THEN COALESCE( policy.completion_deadline_local_time IS NOT NULL OR policy.dependency_completion_window_seconds > 0, false) END AS policy_enabled, CASE WHEN target.alert_type = 'JOB_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE' THEN COALESCE(child_job.execution_started_at, CASE WHEN closed.opportunity_closed_at IS NOT NULL AND child_job.execution_started_at IS NULL THEN closed.opportunity_closed_at END) ELSE COALESCE(completed.finished_at, closed.opportunity_closed_at) END AS recovered_at, CASE WHEN target.alert_type = 'JOB_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE' AND child_job.execution_started_at IS NULL AND closed.opportunity_closed_at IS NOT NULL OR target.alert_type = 'JOB_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE' AND completed.finished_at IS NULL AND closed.opportunity_closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'OPPORTUNITY_CLOSED' ELSE 'RECOVERED' END AS recovery_reason FROM target JOIN batch.trigger_request request ON request.tenant_id = target.tenant_id AND request.id = target.resource_id AND request.parent_workflow_run_id IS NOT NULL JOIN batch.job_definition definition ON definition.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND definition.job_code = request.job_code LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT stored.* FROM batch.job_monitoring_policy stored WHERE stored.tenant_id = definition.tenant_id AND stored.job_definition_id = definition.id FOR SHARE ) policy ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT source.* FROM ( SELECT job.id, job.execution_started_at, job.finished_at, job.instance_status, job.dry_run FROM batch.job_instance job WHERE job.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND (job.trigger_request_id = request.id OR job.id = request.related_job_instance_id) UNION ALL SELECT job.id, job.execution_started_at, job.finished_at, job.instance_status, job.dry_run FROM archive.job_instance_archive job WHERE job.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND (job.trigger_request_id = request.id OR job.id = request.related_job_instance_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.job_instance hot WHERE hot.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND hot.id = job.id) ) source ORDER BY source.execution_started_at DESC NULLS LAST, source.finished_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) child_job ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT source.* FROM ( SELECT run.id, run.run_status, run.finished_at, run.updated_at, run.dry_run FROM batch.workflow_run run WHERE run.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND run.id = request.parent_workflow_run_id UNION ALL SELECT run.id, run.run_status, run.finished_at, run.updated_at, run.dry_run FROM archive.workflow_run_archive run WHERE run.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND run.id = request.parent_workflow_run_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.workflow_run hot WHERE hot.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND hot.id = run.id) ) source LIMIT 1 ) parent ON true LEFT JOIN batch.batch_day_waiting_launch batch_day_wait ON batch_day_wait.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND batch_day_wait.request_id = request.request_id LEFT JOIN batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch dependency_wait ON dependency_wait.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND dependency_wait.request_id = request.request_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN child_job.instance_status IN ( 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED', 'SUCCESS_DRY_RUN', 'FAILED_DRY_RUN') THEN child_job.finished_at END AS finished_at ) completed CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN request.request_status IN ('REJECTED', 'DUPLICATE', 'GIVE_UP') THEN request.updated_at WHEN batch_day_wait.wait_status IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED') THEN batch_day_wait.updated_at WHEN dependency_wait.wait_status = 'CANCELLED' THEN dependency_wait.updated_at WHEN parent.run_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'TERMINATED') THEN COALESCE(parent.finished_at, parent.updated_at) WHEN child_job.instance_status IN ( 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED', 'SUCCESS_DRY_RUN', 'FAILED_DRY_RUN') AND child_job.execution_started_at IS NULL THEN child_job.finished_at ELSE NULL END AS opportunity_closed_at ) closed WHERE target.alert_type IN ('JOB_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE', 'JOB_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE') AND target.resource_kind = 'workflow_job_request' AND target.detail_json ->> 'monitoringResourceKey' = 'workflow_job_request:' || target.resource_id AND request.dry_run = false AND parent.id IS NOT NULL AND parent.dry_run = false AND (child_job.id IS NULL OR child_job.dry_run = false) ), workflow_identity AS ( SELECT target.id AS alert_id, target.tenant_id, target.alert_type, target.definition_id, target.resource_id AS run_id, NULL::text AS request_id, NULL::timestamptz AS opportunity_closed_at FROM target WHERE target.alert_type = 'WORKFLOW_RUNNING_TOO_LONG' AND target.resource_kind = 'workflow_run' AND target.detail_json ->> 'monitoringResourceKey' = 'workflow_run:' || target.resource_id UNION ALL SELECT target.id, target.tenant_id, target.alert_type, occurrence.workflow_definition_id, NULL::bigint, occurrence.request_id, CASE WHEN occurrence.occurrence_status IN ( 'SKIPPED_CALENDAR', 'MISFIRE_SKIPPED', 'READINESS_TIMEOUT', 'CLOSED_DAY_REJECTED', 'SUPERSEDED') THEN occurrence.updated_at END FROM target JOIN batch.scheduled_occurrence occurrence ON occurrence.tenant_id = target.tenant_id AND occurrence.id = target.resource_id AND occurrence.workflow_definition_id = target.definition_id WHERE target.alert_type IN ('WORKFLOW_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE', 'WORKFLOW_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE') AND target.detail_json ->> 'monitoringResourceKey' = 'scheduled_occurrence:' || occurrence.id UNION ALL SELECT target.id, target.tenant_id, target.alert_type, occurrence.workflow_definition_id, NULL::bigint, occurrence.trigger_request_id, CASE WHEN occurrence.occurrence_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') THEN occurrence.updated_at END FROM target JOIN batch.expected_work_occurrence occurrence ON occurrence.tenant_id = target.tenant_id AND occurrence.id = target.resource_id AND occurrence.workflow_definition_id = target.definition_id WHERE target.alert_type IN ('WORKFLOW_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE', 'WORKFLOW_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE') AND target.detail_json ->> 'monitoringResourceKey' = 'expected_work_occurrence:' || occurrence.id ), workflow_state AS ( SELECT identity.alert_id, CASE identity.alert_type WHEN 'WORKFLOW_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE' THEN COALESCE(policy.start_grace_seconds > 0, false) WHEN 'WORKFLOW_NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE' THEN policy.completion_deadline_local_time IS NOT NULL WHEN 'WORKFLOW_RUNNING_TOO_LONG' THEN COALESCE(policy.soft_runtime_seconds > 0, false) END AS policy_enabled, CASE WHEN identity.alert_type = 'WORKFLOW_NOT_STARTED_BY_DEADLINE' THEN COALESCE(source.started_at, completed.finished_at, CASE WHEN source.id IS NULL THEN identity.opportunity_closed_at END) ELSE COALESCE(completed.finished_at, CASE WHEN source.id IS NULL THEN identity.opportunity_closed_at END) END AS recovered_at, CASE WHEN source.id IS NULL THEN 'OPPORTUNITY_CLOSED' ELSE 'RECOVERED' END AS recovery_reason FROM workflow_identity identity LEFT JOIN batch.trigger_request request ON request.tenant_id = identity.tenant_id AND request.request_id = identity.request_id AND request.workflow_definition_id = identity.definition_id AND request.parent_workflow_run_id IS NULL LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT run.id, run.started_at, run.finished_at, run.run_status, run.dry_run FROM batch.workflow_run run WHERE run.tenant_id = identity.tenant_id AND run.workflow_definition_id = identity.definition_id AND (run.id = identity.run_id OR (identity.run_id IS NULL AND run.trigger_request_id = request.id)) UNION ALL SELECT run.id, run.started_at, run.finished_at, run.run_status, run.dry_run FROM archive.workflow_run_archive run WHERE run.tenant_id = identity.tenant_id AND run.workflow_definition_id = identity.definition_id AND (run.id = identity.run_id OR (identity.run_id IS NULL AND run.trigger_request_id = request.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batch.workflow_run hot WHERE hot.tenant_id = identity.tenant_id AND hot.id = run.id) ) source ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT stored.* FROM batch.workflow_monitoring_policy stored WHERE stored.tenant_id = identity.tenant_id AND stored.workflow_definition_id = identity.definition_id FOR SHARE ) policy ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN source.run_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'TERMINATED', 'SUCCESS_DRY_RUN', 'FAILED_DRY_RUN') THEN source.finished_at END AS finished_at ) completed WHERE (identity.run_id IS NULL OR source.id IS NOT NULL) AND COALESCE(source.dry_run, false) = false AND COALESCE(request.dry_run, false) = false ), states AS ( SELECT * FROM job_state UNION ALL SELECT * FROM job_request_state UNION ALL SELECT * FROM workflow_state ), resolution AS ( SELECT states.alert_id, states.recovered_at, CASE WHEN states.policy_enabled THEN states.recovery_reason ELSE 'POLICY_DISABLED' END AS reason FROM states JOIN target ON target.id = states.alert_id WHERE NOT states.policy_enabled OR (states.recovered_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.alert_notification_receipt receipt WHERE receipt.tenant_id = target.tenant_id AND receipt.dedup_fingerprint = target.dedup_fingerprint AND receipt.firing_delivered_at >= target.first_seen_at)) ) UPDATE batch.alert_event alert SET status = #{closedStatus}, closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, close_reason = resolution.reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, detail_json = COALESCE(alert.detail_json, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object( 'monitoringRecoveredAt', CASE WHEN resolution.reason = 'POLICY_DISABLED' THEN NULL ELSE resolution.recovered_at END, 'monitoringResolutionReason', resolution.reason, 'monitoringResolutionObservedAt', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) FROM target JOIN resolution ON resolution.alert_id = target.id WHERE alert.id = target.id AND alert.tenant_id = target.tenant_id AND alert.status = #{entity.status} AND alert.closed_at IS NULL AND alert.updated_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{entity.updatedAt} RETURNING alert.*
